title: Hundredth monkey effect on Japanese islands

tellings.quote: island of monkeys certain type of monkey I think it's in Japan that they have a species of monkeys that's separated by an island

plain: The hundredth monkey effect is the idea that once enough animals in one group learn a new habit, it suddenly appears in others they never meet, and it is said to come from a kind of monkey living on islands in Japan, kept apart by the water. A guest named Randy Anderson, who says he saw alien technology on a military base, brings it up from what he was told, unsure of the details. He uses it to suggest that minds may be linked in ways that do not need contact.
